headline: Unplanned easy treadmill run, done right: 57min at 113bpm. No plan change, the block needs repointing.
summary:
Review mode. No session was planned for today (the Valtellina block ended with the race on 7 Nov). You ran 8.0km on the treadmill in 57min, 0m D+, load 33. Average HR was 113 and max 158, RPE 1, feel 2 (Good). That is a true easy run, well inside Z1 (<=141), with none of the Z3 drift your easy days usually show. It was flat, so the treadmill undercount for incline sessions doesn't apply and 33 stands as logged.

Readiness: HRV 80 is your best in 28 days (77 yesterday). RHR 45 is also the low. Sleep was 5.9h. That misses the green bar (>6h) but isn't amber (<5.5h), so it's green on recovery markers with sleep as the limiter, as usual.

Load: CTL 53.0, ATL 45.3, TSB about +7.7. Since the race you've logged 138 (Wed 11, 24.9km), 142 (Sun 15 Presolana, 19.6km / 1188m D+, RPE 8, max HR 181) and 33 today. That's 313 over the last 7 days, and the body is absorbing it: HRV went 51 to 77 to 80 after Sunday. CTL has held at 53-55 since race day.

The plan has no weeks or sessions past 8 Nov, so this run can't edit anything. The next block (race, baseline, weeks) needs to be set up in the coaching chat.
flags: Plan block finished: there are no planned sessions after 7 Nov. Set up the next race and weeks in the coaching chat so CTL doesn't drift down from 53 without a plan.
Sleep 5.9h is still under 6h even with HRV at 80. Sleep is still the limiter.
Sun 15 Presolana was a hard effort 8 days after the race (RPE 8, max HR 181, 1188m D+). It went fine (feel 1), but keep the next 2-3 days easy until the new block is built.
